CustomField.description: Label rendered beside the Likert Matrix total row's score when Show_Total_Score__c is on (#144), for example "GAD-7 total" or "Satisfaction score". Blank falls back to a generic Total Score label at runtime. Plain text; renders through the standard label merge pipeline so {{merge}} fields resolve.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The wording shown next to the total under the matrix, such as GAD-7 Total or Satisfaction Score. Leave blank for a generic Total Score label.
CustomField.label: Total Score Label
